sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Tirumala Devi Eada
 Criminal Petition No.12951 of 2025
Order:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') seeking the Court to quash the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.715 of 2025, on the file of Keesara Police Station, Medchal- Malkajgiri District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 468 and 471 r/w 34 of IPC.

entities.text: Keesara Police Station, Medchal- Malkajgiri District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri M.Ratan Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners as well as Sri Jitender Rao Veeramalla, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners are being questioned by the Police and that they are not concerned with the alleged offence and therefore prayed to quash the proceedings against the petitioners.
4. Perused the record.
It is observed that the petitioners are not arrayed as accused in the FIR.

The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted the same stating that as on date, as per the instructions dated 06.10.2025 received from the Sub-Inspector of Police, Keesara Police Station,
Rachakonda Commissionerate, the ETD, J Crl.P_12951_2025 petitioners herein are not shown as accused and that A1 and others are absconding.
In this backdrop, when the petitioners' counsel is questioned as to his locus standi to file the present petition, he says that the petitioners are apprehending threat of arrest from the Police.
This is not a petition to entertain the said submission and grant any relief.
Hence the petition lacks merits and the same is liable to be dismissed.
5. In the result, the Criminal Petition is dismissed.
6. Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
_ __ JUSTICE TIRUMALA DEVI EADA Dt:08.10.2025 ysk ETD, J Crl.P_12951_2025 THE HON'BLE SMT.
